name: service-schedule
title: Customer service schedule
for_each: select id,code from accounts order by code

sections.title: Customer
sections.sql: select code,name,owner from accounts where id=$1

sections.title: Service records
sections.note: Internal working schedule. Check contract and carrier records before sharing. Monthly figures exclude tax and usage.
sections.sql: select r.code,r.site,r.name,r.carrier,r.carrier_reference,r.status,r.currency,r.charge_cents,r.cost_cents,r.contract_end from service_register r join services s on s.id=r.id where s.account_id=$1 order by r.code

name: change-paper
title: Service change working paper
for_each: select id,code from change_orders order by code

sections.title: Recorded customer instruction and completion
sections.note: Draft working paper only. Not a carrier instruction or evidence of a live network change.

sections.title: Service
sections.sql: select r.code,r.account,r.site,r.name,r.carrier,r.carrier_reference,r.status,r.currency,r.charge_cents,r.cost_cents,r.contract_end from service_register r join change_orders o on o.service_id=r.id where o.id=$1

sections.title: Carrier task evidence
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,closed_on,evidence from carrier_tasks where order_id=$1 order by due_on

name: renewal-brief
title: Service renewal brief
for_each: select id,code from services where status='active' order by code

sections.title: Current service terms
sections.note: Internal review, not an automatic renewal or quote. Confirm current terms with the customer and carrier.

sections.title: Change history
sections.sql: select code,kind,status,due_on,authorisation_reference,completion_reference from change_orders where service_id=$1 order by requested_on
